description: StockMap's published calls on two to five US stocks side by side, the same for every reader, by symbol or company name: each stock's nightly 14-day read (a call or a lean), whether it changed last night, the insights for and against it, and how the model's past calls on it did. Use it when someone asks how two to five US stocks stack up against each other, or which of them the model's calls read stronger. Each answer carries the not-advice line and the run date.
